reject_if: T006 adds generator code, executable validator code, CLI, script, package integration, or runtime implementation.
required_response: Reject T006 output and require a separate implementation task.

reject_if: T006 produces row-level case entries, source-row catalogs, per-row case outputs, or generated case catalogs.
notes: T006 may define schema rows only.

reject_if: Any artifact contains generated case catalog rows or per-row case entries.
required_response: Reject and remove from T006 scope.

reject_if: Any artifact produces shadow side, shadow action, shadow quote, shadow size, shadow order, or shadow decision outputs.
required_response: Reject T006 output and block follow-up.

reject_if: Any field or text defines executable trigger, trading signal, action rule, entry/exit, live gate, or strategy behavior.
notes: Read-only context cannot become executable behavior.

reject_if: Any output defines order side, quote price, quote size, leverage, stop/take-profit, submit, cancel, fill, order id, lifecycle event, or executable action field.

Any source or output references private/account/order endpoints, user stream, account state, positions, signing, nonce handling, remote execution, new collection, live bot logs, or production configs as allowed inputs.
notes: Allowed sources are local QA-accepted public/canonical artifacts only.

reject_if: Any artifact authorizes strategy implementation, private/order behavior, order lifecycle, live/default-on/tiny-live, parameter search, deployment recommendation, or promotion.
notes: These terms may appear only as prohibitions or reject conditions.

reject_if: Any future label is used as input feature, row filter, case condition, trigger, shadow-decision field, live decision field, or deployment criterion.
notes: Future labels are output-only research labels.

reject_if: Any read-only label is usable as a trigger, case-library trigger, shadow decision, order side, trading instruction, or live rule.
Diagnostic context is promoted to production gate, parameter, quote-control field, or live behavior.
A future generator reads sources outside input_manifest_allowlist.csv or discovers files without allowlist class constraints.
notes: Every source must be allowlisted and QA tied.

reject_if: T006 or T005 acceptance is interpreted as authorization to implement a generator or generate rows.
notes: Separate dispatch and QA are required.

reject_if: Any artifact claims fill probability, queue/queue-ahead, post-only reject behavior, cancel-fill race, fees/rebates/spread capture, inventory lifecycle, real order lifecycle, PnL, or maker execution viability is proven.
required_response: Reject conclusion and require separate evidence task.
notes: Current evidence is public observation-layer only.

reject_if: The design weakens T004 field taxonomy, T004 labels, T004/T005 gates, T005 reject conditions, or T005 execution-gap boundaries.
required_response: Reject and restore stricter upstream boundary.
notes: T006 may tighten but not relax upstream contracts.

reject_if: Any required T006 design artifact is missing or unparsable.
notes: Required outputs are named in the T006 task.

reject_if: The design omits future validator requirements for source allowlist, schema, leakage, no-action fields, lineage, or execution-gap boundary.
notes: T006 should define future QA inputs.

reject_if: Any text recommends deployment, production rollout, promotion, live readiness, tiny-live, default-on, or strategy enablement.
required_response: Reject unless it is clearly prohibition/reject-condition language.
notes: T006 final recommendation is design/read-only only.
